correctness.rationale: The neighborhood guard is exactly x_i=0 => Y-y_i>=2 and y_i=0 => X-x_i>=2 with X,Y side sums. Partition (X,Y) into both >=4 (H_n²), exactly one <=3 (2∑z^a T(B_a)), both <=3 (X,Y in {2,3}). In low-low, c22=n+binom(n,2), c23=n²(n−1) per orientation, c33=binom(n,3)²+n(n−1)²(n−2)+n²(n−1); disjoint supports yield displayed polynomial. All weights >=4, coefficient at z4 is c22 plus two all-one-side configurations only for n=4. I independently enumerated all 3^(2n) labeled assignments for n=4,5,6, totaling 597051 assignments, and checked every coefficient against an independently coded polynomial; this finite validation is distinct from general side-total proof.
